اغرندين (form IIIq)
# اِغْرَنْدَيْنَ (iḡrandayna) /iɣ.ran.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اُغْرُنْدِينَ (uḡrundīna) /uɣ.run.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اِغْرَنْدِينَ (iḡrandīna) /iɣ.ran.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
